tax_litigation.as_last_disclosed: The Company had paid GST on Royalty @ 12 % at the time of filing GST3B relying on Sr.no 1 of the Notification No. 10/2017-1GST (Rate) dated 28" June 2017 till August 2022 under a bona fide impression that GST Rate applicable to the said transaction is 12%. During the annual internal review, it was observed there was a new notification No. 06/2021 - Central Tax (Rate) Dated 30-09-2021, which levied tax @ 18% on such transaction with immediate effect. Accordingly, a differential provision of 6% on Royalty was created in the books on 1st September 2022 and was paid along with applicable Interest on 15th October 2022. Despite the Suo-moto compliance, the Department passed the Order dated 13.05.2025 and has imposed a penalty for short payment of GST.
tax_litigation.status: The Company has filed appeal before the Additional /Joint Commissioner (Appeals) of CGST and Central Excise, Vadodara on 13-06-2025.

operating_notes.text: R-32 production commenced in March 2026; capacity over 10,000 tonnes now, ramping to 20,000 tonnes.
LiPF6 salt fully qualified by most major global electrolyte players; LFP final qualification expected by Q3FY27.
Battery materials capex of ₹1,900-2,000 Cr invested so far against a ₹6,000 Cr plan by FY28.
R32 capacity is almost fully utilised; the expansion is expected to take total capacity to 20,000 tonnes, with full utilisation expected in calendar 2027.
About 40-50% of R32 sales are on long-term contracts, with the rest spot or contract-to-contract, and domestic and export prices are said to be very close.
Battery materials: LiPF6 qualification almost finished, PVDF close to finalisation, and LFP cathode active material revenue expected towards the end of FY27.
